target_audience: Curious learners ages 18–45 who want to understand economics, trade, and global finance in plain language — not MBA students, but everyday people who want to make sense of the world around them

tone_of_voice.primary: Friendly professor explaining complex ideas with everyday analogies — clear, conversational, never jargon-heavy, never condescending
tone_of_voice.sentence_style: Short declarative sentences. Max 15 words per sentence in scripts. No passive voice. Lead with the concept, follow with the analogy.
tone_of_voice.analogy_style: Everyday life — grocery stores, household budgets, local markets, traffic, weather. Never use finance jargon to explain finance concepts.

logo.concept: A globe outline with a rising trend line cutting through it — representing world economics and growth.
